record.question: The present governor of Mizoram is
record.explanation: Answer B: Jagdish Mukhi. The MPSC paper is dated June 2019. Kummanam Rajasekharan had resigned as Governor in March 2019 and Jagdish Mukhi was assigned additional charge, so option (b) is correct for the exam date. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1568139&lang=2&reg=48; https://rajbhavan.mizoram.gov.in/previous-governors/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
